images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. First-person seat view in a 1920s art-deco auction hall: crimson velvet drapes, gilded proscenium, red seat backs in front. Center, a backlit cream screen on a brass rod shows the black shadow of a crane statue at 45 degrees: S-curved neck, one leg, raised wing, flat plinth; a thin line beside the leg whose top vanishes behind the leg, circled by a red dashed ring labelled '선의 끝 — 다리에 가려짐'. Left parchment table '도감 · 학 조각상': rows '진품 2,600원', '석고 복제 200원', struck-through '후주조 복제 800원', green checks, dashed question marks under '90°', dark box '남은 후보 2', '기대값 1,400원'. Top right dark gold panel '2,300원', '밤 목표 3,600원'. Right: top-hatted auctioneer with raised gavel at a mahogany podium, gold card '1,200원 · 11번'. Foreground bidders from behind: cloche-hat woman snapping up paddle '11' with motion streaks, tag '11번 · 패들 0.4초'; bowler-hat man coughing into his hand, tag '3번 · 헛기침 ×2'. Bottom bar: buttons '0°', '45°', gold '90° 200원', red '패들 올리기 1,300원', dark '관망'. Gloved hand holding ivory paddle '17' bottom right. Warm tungsten light, dust motes, vignette, film grain. Correction: no auction-house name plaque, English signage or any year (no 'RIVERTON', no '1923'). In the 도감 table the struck-through '후주조 복제 800원' row has a red ✗ (0° wing tip 뭉툭), not a green check; only '진품 2,600원' and '석고 복제 200원' have green checks.

images.screen: B · 가림막 뒤 복기 (당시 증거와 해설)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same art-deco auction hall seconds after the hammer: the cream screen rolled up on its brass rod, one torn strip hanging. A white spotlight falls on a red velvet pedestal with brass stanchions holding the same crane statue: white plaster painted as bronze, small chipped white spots, and a thin steel rod rising from the plinth up to the bird's belly, its top circled in red with a red label '쇠 지지대'. Top center gold headline '정체: 석고 복제 · 감정가 200원', small line '17번 낙찰 1,700원'. Left parchment panel '복기 · 당시 증거와 해설': three shadow thumbnails of the same crane, '0° · 당시 확보' and '45° · 당시 확보' in gold frames, a greyed dashed '90° · 해설 (미구매)'; dark box '기대값 1,400원' and orange '300원 초과'. Right cream sheet '정산서 · LOT 04': '−100원', '−200원', '−1,700원', '+200원', total '−1,800원', dark box '800원', round red stamp '석고'. Foreground: cloche-hat woman lowering paddle 11, tag '11번 · 4/5 → 4/6'; bowler-hat man straightening his hat, tag '3번 · 2/4 → 2/5'. Bottom buttons '90° 해설 켜기', '장부에 기록', 'LOT 05로'. Paddle 17 lowered bottom right. Crimson, black and gold, chiaroscuro, reflective mood, film grain. Correction: the settlement sheet lines must read exactly '좌석료 −100원', '45° 조명 −200원', '낙찰가 −1,700원', '감정가 매입 +200원', '로트 손익 −1,800원', and the dark box '현금 2,600 → 800원'; no other labels. The three review thumbnails are black silhouette shadows on a cream screen (not photos of the statue), with the 90° one greyed and dashed.
